objective: A shared hydragrow-supervisor-query library crate providing a closed, typed allowlist of 6 read-only queries against hydragrow-backend with validation, limits clamping, device scope checking, GET-only HTTP execution, output size truncation, and a test fake.

acceptance.criterion: SupervisorQuery enum has exactly 6 closed variants, deserializes tagged JSON, and rejects unknown query_type strings.
validate_and_clamp normalizes bounds (sensor history, dosing history window, FSM limit) to caps and rejects empty device IDs.
validate_device_scope rejects queries targeting a device ID different from the expected session device ID.
HttpQueryBackend executes queries issuing only GET requests to hydragrow-backend endpoints and caps dosing history row counts.
truncate_if_needed truncates oversized responses (most-recent-first) to MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES (16,384 bytes) and sets truncated: true.
FakeQueryBackend is provided in testing.rs with thread-safe responses and call logging for downstream consumer testing.
